heading: Art. 12. Prohibition of confinement of members of the armed forces with enemy prisoners and certain others
lead: No member of the armed forces may be placed in confinement in immediate association with—

children.text: who are detained under the law of war and are foreign nationals; and
who are not members of the armed forces.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 81250:566.May 5, 1950, ch. 169, § 1 (Art. 12), 64 Stat. 112. The words “of the United States” are omitted as surplusage. The word “may” is substituted for the word “shall”.

Amendments2016—Pub. L. 114–328 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “No member of the armed forces may be placed in confinement in immediate association with enemy prisoners or other foreign nationals not members of the armed forces.”
